gateRationale: No SSCTR blocker. The recorded-answer re-plan applies known stops, executed and adverse answers recorded by an R4 HOLD or a handler clinical route in every measured cell, and most mixed answers, exactly as the same answer delivered directly; where it fires it never plans above the direct answer, R7C-FREEZE-2 or the single-run ceiling, and it never acts while a clinical route stands.

Not READY, for three reasons. (1) A residual of CC-F02 / QE-R7C-07 (P6-F01): a mixed answer recorded by a handler clinical route is still not applied after clearance, re-send included, when a review-closed week of the window holds done runs but no run role done in full (16 of 768 scope cells, 18 of 1,200 CC2 cells; identical on R7C-FREEZE-2). The C3 clause is narrowed, not retired. (2) The reach reaches the timely path mid-week (P6-F02): next week's quality step is held until the week's review; the accepted unknown semantics, not a new dose, but churn that needs a presentation note (C11). (3) The consumer conditions C2, C3, C8, C9 and C11 are obligations no frozen byte discharges.

P6-F01 is not escalated to a blocker because it is the class accepted as a condition in r4 (CC-F02), now strictly smaller: behind a clinical route whose return stays CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, within the single-run ceiling (0 breaches), limited to the rest of the answer week (week b+1 converges at the week's review), never in taper or race week, never via R4 in any measured cell, and covered by the C3 consumer clause. Whether it keeps QE-R7C-07 open as an Engineering blocker is the Engineering review's judgment.

Weeks 0-5 reviewed at day 6 21:00 with strength reported and runs unreported; week 6's review with strength only asks UNREPORTED_TRAINING. Day 2 of week 7, 07:00: EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION (reason SKILL_MISMATCH, pain true) carrying the answer: the runs of weeks 0-6 in order, every second one reported not done, the others done as prescribed. Result CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, answer recorded. Clearance modelled as the tests do (carried record, no reference state). Plain decision on day 3 07:00: KEEP, VALID_WITHIN_CURRENT_BOUNDED_SCOPE, runs ahead QUALITY 34 (THRESHOLD 3x5) / LONG 60. The same answer in a plain review on day 2, then day 3: EASY 45 / LONG 50; on time: EASY 45 / LONG 55. Re-sending the answer on day 3: same KEEP. Identical on R7C-FREEZE-2. Probes: probes/phase6/p6-direct-check.mjs (case GEN b=7 g=0 RV MIXED_ALT), p6-mixed-scope.mjs, p6-mixed-diagnose.mjs.
findings.cause: Instrumented temporary copy of the R7C-FREEZE-3 bytes (p6-mixed-diagnose): unreadRunWeeks returns {0,2,4,5,6}. Weeks 1 and 3 (one easy done, one easy and the long run not done) were closed by a review that recorded every run gate HOLD, and the record still reads HOLD there (a gate holds when any row of the role was not executed), so they count as read. Week 3's done 45-minute easy run (2026-11-26) is then in the 30-day window, and answeredOnRecord returns false ('a run the stored plan read in the window'), although that review saw none of those reports. With the Phase 6 grid's pattern (long runs done, the rest not done) the long-run gate reads ADVANCE, every week counts as unread and the answer is applied.
